chunks: And from him (Al-Hassan ibn Ali) from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, he raised it (to the Imam), saying:
"Whoever leaves Mecca while not intending to return to it, his appointed time has drawn near and his punishment has approached."
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of intention when leaving Mecca according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In the context of the chapter on expiation for unintentional violations during Hajj, this hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* links the physical act of leaving Mecca to the spiritual state of the pilgrim. It serves as a warning that a lack of intention to return signifies a detachment from the sacred bond with the House of God, thereby hastening one's death and divine retribution.
